title: 第359章 核心海域妖帝降临第358章 内海真龙海域
content_zh:
核心海域，万族圣殿深处。
九尊身着古老海族圣袍、气息沉寂万古的老者缓缓睁眼，眼底皆充斥着亘古不灭的怒火与杀意。他们皆是天仙巅峰的海域至尊，坐镇核心海域，俯瞰凡界万古沧桑。
“人族小辈，欺我海族太甚！”
“外海尽毁，内海残破，监察使殉道，若不诛杀此獠，我无尽海域亿万族群，颜面何存！”
“凡界之力，已然无法制衡此人，唯有跨界向妖界求援！”
九位长老对视一眼，瞬间达成共识。他们深知，追梦金仙肉身无敌、剑道通天，凡界所有战力尽出，也无法将其镇压，唯有借上界之力！
当即，长老团全员出手，开启海域最古老的献祭大阵。
无尽海域亿万年积攒的镇域神材、本源灵髓、龙族圣血、鲲鹏残骨，无数足以让凡界修士疯狂的天材地宝，尽数被投入献祭大阵之中。璀璨至极的七彩灵光直冲星海，撕裂界面壁垒，沟通妖界！
海量的至宝本源化作最诚挚的请援之力，穿透诸天屏障，传入妖界高层，寻求至强者出手，镇压入侵凡界的人族金仙！
无数珍宝、无尽底蕴的献祭，在外人看来已是惊天手笔，足以打动任何一尊大能。
可无人知晓，真正让妖界那位无上至尊动心、毅然跨界出手的根本缘由，从不是这些献祭资源。
瞬息之后，妖界九天之上，一道苍茫古老、横跨万古的淡漠神念，穿透界面壁垒，笼罩整片起源界无尽海域。
“吾，归墟妖尊，念故土血脉存续，跨界一战。”
一声神语落定，天地震颤、四海悲鸣！
一尊屹立妖界之巅、成就仙帝境界的无上强者，踏破虚空壁垒，缓缓降临起源界！
这位归墟妖尊，乃是妖界真正的巨擘、顶级仙帝。
无人知晓，他的根，从来不在高高在上的妖界，而是在这起源界的无尽海域！
亿万年之前，归墟妖尊便是起源界无尽海域孕育的无上妖尊，纵横凡界、碾压万族，是无尽海域有史以来最天赋异禀的至尊海族。后来他打破凡界桎梏、撕裂界面壁垒，飞升妖界，一路征战杀伐，登顶仙帝之位，成为一方诸天巨头。
亿万年过去，他身居妖界高位，却从未断绝与故土的血脉羁绊。如今无尽海域亿万海族，九成以上都流淌着他当年遗留的稀薄血脉，整片海域，皆是他的后裔族群、血脉故土。
海族长老团的献祭求援，看似是以宝请援，实则是血脉共鸣、故土告急！

目睹后裔族群惨遭屠戮、故土海域满目疮痍，归墟妖尊焉能坐视不理？
仙帝威压缓缓铺开，笼罩整片起源界十大超级大陆与无尽海域，天地规则剧烈震颤，凡界天地屏障濒临破碎！
起源界虽经郭芙之手百倍扩容，天地底蕴大幅暴涨，灵气复苏、规则加固，足以承载金仙境的极致厮杀，可仙帝级的战力，早已超脱凡界上限，触及天道本源层级。
这般无上伟力，一旦在起源界境内全力开战，整片起源界必将寸寸崩碎、大陆沉没、星辰陨落，亿万生灵尽数化为飞灰！
虚空之中，追梦感知到那股凌驾诸天、碾压金仙的无上仙帝气息，瞳孔微凝，却无半分惧意，唯有寻亲的执念愈发坚定。
他心中无比清醒，绝对不能在起源界开战。
这片天地，是他的根基故土。这里有他一手创建的邹家、邹府、邹城，有他朝夕相伴的一众道侣，有并肩修行的结拜兄妹，有倾力守护的亲友门徒，有他所有的牵挂与羁绊。一旦起源界破碎，他所有珍视之人，尽数难逃陨落之灾。
而另一边，踏空降临的归墟妖尊，眼底杀机凛然，却同样克制着自身的无上力量，未曾贸然出手。
他心中自有两大忌惮，绝不允许起源界破碎。
其一，是因果大道桎梏。仙帝修士，已然触及诸天因果本源，一言一行、一举一动皆牵缠无边业力。若他在凡界打碎起源界，覆灭亿万无辜生灵，滔天杀戮因果、破灭天地业力会尽数缠身，桎梏他的大道前路，彻底断绝他冲击神人境的机会，万年苦修、仙帝道基，或将一朝尽毁。
其二，是血脉存续之念。无尽海域是他的诞生之地，整片海族万族皆是他的血脉后裔。起源界一旦崩塌，无尽海域随之覆灭，他遗留万古的所有血脉族群尽数断绝，亿万年血脉传承彻底归零，这是他绝对无法接受的代价。
两大忌惮高悬，让这位无上仙帝，不敢在起源界境内展露全部战力。
四目隔空相对，一人一帝心思默契，不谋而合。
下一秒，两道横贯整个起源宇宙的身影，同时破空而起，冲破起源界大气层，脱离凡界天地桎梏，直奔起源界无垠星空深处！
那里无天地桎梏、无生灵羁绊、无因果缠身，乃是绝佳战场，可任由二人倾尽全力、生死对决，无需顾忌半分后果。
星空浩瀚，星辰亿万。
追梦立身黑暗星海之中，周身七彩仙光璀璨夺目，盘龙战甲神威赫赫，青霄剑悬浮身前，剑鸣震彻星海。金仙二层巅峰的肉身道力、九转神功的无敌体魄、万千剑道底蕴尽数开启，做好迎战仙帝巨头的万全准备。
归墟妖尊悬浮对面，一身妖帝帝袍猎猎作响，仙帝威压席卷整片星海，亿万星辰为之震颤、黯淡，周身妖道本源流转，举手投足间，便有覆灭诸天的无上威势。
追梦以金仙境2层巅峰，对战妖界天仙帝！
一场横跨凡界与妖界、颠覆修行认知、亘古罕见的终极对决，在起源界星空深处，正式拉开序幕。

星海风声肃杀，天地寂然无声。

content_en:
The core sea area, deep in the temple of all races.
The nine old men, dressed in ancient sea clan holy robes and whose auras were silent for eternity, slowly opened their eyes, their eyes filled with eternal anger and murderous intent. They are all sea supremes at the pinnacle of immortality, sitting in the core sea area, overlooking the eternal vicissitudes of the mortal world.
"Junior from the human race, you are bullying my sea race too much!"
"The outer sea is completely destroyed, the inner sea is broken, and the supervisor is martyred. If we don't kill this beast, how can the hundreds of millions of people in our endless sea have any face!"
"The power of the mortal realm is no longer able to control this person, so we can only cross the realm to ask for help from the demon realm!"
The nine elders looked at each other and reached a consensus instantly. They know very well that Dream Chasing Golden Immortal is physically invincible and has a sword that reaches the sky. Even with all the fighting power in the mortal world, they cannot suppress it. They can only borrow the power of the upper world!
Immediately, all members of the elder group took action and opened the oldest sacrificial formation in the sea.
The sacred materials, source spiritual marrow, holy blood of dragons, Kunpeng bones, and countless heavenly materials and earthly treasures that could drive monks from the mortal world crazy, all accumulated in the endless sea area for hundreds of millions of years, were thrown into the sacrificial formation. The extremely bright colorful spiritual light rushes straight into the sea of ​​​​stars, tearing apart interface barriers and communicating with the demon world!
The massive source of treasures turned into the most sincere appeal for help, penetrating the barriers of the heavens and reaching the upper echelons of the demon world, seeking the most powerful person to take action to suppress the human golden immortals who invaded the mortal world!
The sacrifices of countless treasures and endless heritage are already shocking to outsiders, enough to impress any great power.
But no one knows that the fundamental reason why the supreme being in the demon world was tempted and resolutely took action across borders was never these sacrificial resources.
A moment later, above the nine heavens of the demon world, a vast ancient indifferent spiritual thought that spanned eternity penetrated the interface barrier and enveloped the entire endless sea of ​​the origin world.
"I, the Demon Lord of Guixu, want to continue the bloodline of my homeland and fight across borders."
As soon as the divine words were heard, the earth trembled and the whole world screamed!
A supremely powerful man who stood at the top of the demon world and achieved the realm of the Immortal Emperor, broke through the void barrier and slowly descended to the origin world!
This Guixu Demon Lord is the true giant and the top Immortal Emperor in the demon world.
No one knows that his roots have never been in the lofty demon world, but in the endless sea of ​​the origin world!
Billions of years ago, the Guixu Demon Lord was the supreme demon lord born in the endless sea of ​​the origin world. He traversed the mortal world and crushed all races. He was the most gifted and supreme sea race in the history of the endless sea. Later, he broke the shackles of the mortal world, tore apart the interface barriers, ascended to the demon world, fought and killed all the way, ascended to the position of Immortal Emperor, and became a giant in the heavens.
Hundreds of millions of years have passed, and he has held a high position in the demon world, but he has never severed his blood ties with his homeland. Nowadays, more than 90% of the hundreds of millions of sea people in the endless sea are flowing with the thin bloodline he left behind in those days. The entire sea area is his descendant group and bloodline homeland.
The Sea Clan elders' sacrifice to ask for help seems to be asking for help with treasures, but in fact it is a resonance of blood and a crisis for the homeland!
How could the Guixu Demon Lord sit idly by as he witnessed the massacre of his descendants and the devastation of his homeland and sea?
The pressure of the Immortal Emperor slowly spreads, covering the entire ten supercontinents and endless sea areas in the Origin World. The rules of the world are violently shaking, and the barrier between the world and the world is on the verge of breaking!
Although the origin world has been expanded a hundred times by Guo Fu's hands, the foundation of the world has greatly increased, the spiritual energy has been revived, and the rules have been strengthened, it is enough to carry the ultimate fighting in the Golden Fairy Realm, but the combat power of the Immortal Emperor level has already surpassed the upper limit of the mortal world and touched the original level of heaven.
With such supreme power, once an all-out war breaks out within the Origin Realm, the entire Origin Realm will surely collapse, the continent will sink, the stars will fall, and hundreds of millions of living beings will turn into ashes!
In the void, Zhui Meng sensed the aura of the Supreme Immortal Emperor that towered over the heavens and crushed the Golden Immortal. His pupils were slightly condensed, but there was no fear at all. Only his obsession with finding his relatives became more and more determined.
He was extremely clear-headed and could never start a war in the Origin Realm.
This world is his fundamental homeland. Here are the Zou Family, Zou Mansion, and Zou City he founded, as well as a group of Taoist companions who accompany him day and night, andHe has sworn brothers and sisters who practice Buddhism on his shoulders, relatives, friends and disciples who protect him with all their strength, and all his cares and bonds. Once the origin world is shattered, all the people he cherishes will not escape the disaster of death.
On the other side, the Guixu Demon Lord descended from the sky, with murderous intent in his eyes, but he also restrained his supreme power and never made a rash move.
He has two major fears in his heart and will never allow the Origin World to be broken.
One is the shackles of the avenue of cause and effect. Immortal Emperor monks have already touched the source of cause and effect in all heavens, and every word, deed, and action is implicated in boundless karma. If he smashes the origin world in the mortal world and destroys hundreds of millions of innocent creatures, the karma of overwhelming killing and destruction of heaven and earth will be entangled with them all, shackles his path forward, and completely cut off his chance to reach the realm of gods and humans. Thousands of years of hard work and the foundation of the Immortal Emperor may be destroyed in one day.
The second is the thought of continuity of bloodline. The Endless Sea is the place where he was born, and all the races in the sea are descendants of his blood. Once the Origin World collapses, the Endless Sea will be destroyed, all the bloodline groups he left behind will be cut off, and the hundreds of millions of years of bloodline inheritance will be completely reduced to zero. This is a price he absolutely cannot accept.
Two major fears prevented the Supreme Immortal Emperor from displaying his full combat power in the Origin Realm.
The four eyes faced each other across the sky, and one person and one emperor had a tacit understanding and coincided with each other.
The next second, two figures spanning the entire origin universe rose into the sky at the same time, breaking through the atmosphere of the origin world, breaking away from the shackles of the mortal world, and heading straight into the endless starry sky of the origin world!
There is no shackles of heaven and earth, no fetters of living beings, and no entanglement of cause and effect. It is an excellent battlefield where the two of them can use their full strength to fight to the death without worrying about the consequences.
The starry sky is vast, with billions of stars.
Zhui Meng stood in the dark sea of ​​stars, the seven-colored fairy light around him was dazzling, the dragon's armor was majestic, the Qingxiao Sword was suspended in front of him, and the sound of the sword shook the sea of ​​stars. The physical power of the second-level peak of the Golden Immortal, the invincible physique of the nine-turn divine skill, and the countless swordsmanship foundations are all unlocked, and you are fully prepared to face the giant of the Immortal Emperor.
The Gui Xu Demon Lord was floating opposite, wearing the Demon Emperor's imperial robes and making a hunting sound. The pressure of the Immortal Emperor swept across the entire sea of ​​​​stars, causing billions of stars to tremble and dim. The origin of the demonic path around him circulated, and with every move he made, he had the supreme power to destroy the heavens.
Chasing Dreams takes the peak of the 2nd level of the Golden Fairy Realm and fights against the Heavenly Emperor of the Demon Realm!
A rare ultimate showdown spanning the mortal world and the demon world, subverting the understanding of spiritual practice, and rarely seen in ancient times, officially kicked off deep in the starry sky of the origin world.
The sound of the wind in the sea of ​​stars was chilling, and the heaven and earth were silent.
